newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer, off highs with spot off.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer, off highs with spot off.

text.p: COMEX copper ended firmer in moderate trading, but pared most of the day's gains with the spot month settling lower.

"The market is forming a nice base around the 97 to 98 cents per pound area, and we are setting ourselves up for some steady gains," said William O'Neill of Merrill Lynch. "I think the market will move back to that 110 cents level on a gradual basis."
The spreads on LME were staying firm due to tightness around the December date next week when Third Wednesday pricing was due.
"There is some apparent tightness and that is why the market is holding up so," O'Neill said.
Most-active COMEX March copper settled 0.80 cent firmer at 100.35 cents per pound, traded 101.15 to 99.60 cents. Spot December went out 0.75 cent weaker at 103.70 cents.
Volume was estimated at 11,000 lots compared to Tuesday's official 8,391 lots.
Some traders expect LME stocks to show a continued increase when the next report is released Friday.
